buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) Text Clause(s) SCOPE OF WORK A. GENERAL The contractor shall carry out Hydrostatic Pressure Testing and Refilling of fire extinguishers as per applicab le Indian Standards (IS 2190, relevant IS specifications), PESO guidelines wherever applicable and manufacturer's re commendations. The work shall include: 1. Removal of extinguishers from their installed locations. 2. Safe transportation to the service facility. 3. Hydrostatic Pressure Testing.

4. Refilling. 5. Replacement of defective consumables, as applicable, from the following: Ø O-rings Ø Valve washers Ø Safety pins Ø Tamper seals Ø Discharge hose washers Ø Pressure gauge (if defective) Ø Nozzle cleaning 6. Affixing fresh service tag. 7. Submission of Test Certificates. 8. Transportation back to CPP-IPR. 9. Reinstallation at original location. B. Batch-wise Execution The contractor shall execute the work batch-wise so that adequate fire protection remains available throughout the premises. Normally, not more than 20–25% of the installed extinguishers of any building/area shall be removed at o ne time unless specifically permitted by the Engineer-in-Charge. The batch size and sequence shall be finalized mut ually. C. Pickup & Delivery The contractor shall: Ø Remove extinguishers from site, Ø Maintain proper identification, Ø Transport safely, Ø Return the same extinguishers, Ø Reinstall at original location. D. Turnaround Time Maximum completion period after pickup: Ø ABC Dry Powder : 15 Days Ø CO₂ : 21 Days Ø Clean Agent : 21 Days

Ø Foam : 15 Days Ø Water : 15 Days E. Hydro Pressure Test Hydrostatic testing shall be carried out as per applicable IS Standards. Any cylinder failing hydro test shall Ø immediately be segregated, Ø declared unserviceable, Ø not be refilled, Ø be returned separately with failure report. F. Refilling Refilling shall be carried out using only ISI marked extinguishing media. Examples: Ø MAP Powder 90 conforming to IS 14609 Ø CO₂ as per IS 307 Ø Dry Nitrogen Ø HFC Clean Agent Ø Mechanical Foam Compound G. Tagging Each extinguisher shall be provided with weather-proof service tag containing Ø Serial Number Ø Type Ø Capacity Ø Location Ø Refilling Date Ø Hydro Test Date Ø Next Due Date Ø Contractor Name Ø Signature

H. Standards The work shall comply with Ø IS 2190 Ø Relevant IS Standards for extinguisher type Ø PESO requirements Ø Manufacturer recommendations ADDITIONAL TERMS & CONDITIONS 1. The work shall be executed batch-wise as decided mutually with Engineer-in-Charge. 2. Contractor shall arrange pickup, transportation, unloading and reinstallation at no extra cost. 3. Each extinguisher shall be removal and reinstalled at the same location. 4. Contractor shall be responsible for any damage or loss during transportation. 5. Hydrostatic Pressure Test Certificates shall be submitted for every tested cylinder. 6. CO₂ cylinders shall be tested only at PESO-approved testing facilities wherever applicable. 7. Failed cylinders shall not be refilled and shall be returned with detailed failure report. 8. Only ISI marked extinguishing media shall be used. 9. Work shall be completed within the stipulated turnaround period. 10. All labour safety requirements, PPE, PF, ESI and insurance shall remain contractor's responsibility. 11. The work area shall be kept clean after completion. 12. Payment shall be released after successful completion, submission of certificates and certification by Engineer-in-Ch arge.
